correctness.rationale: The section-2 normalized quotient has derivative DTheta=(mu/(Lambda sum k)) sum k DJ_k, cancelling Lambda/mu in incidence. Equal per-class recruitment gives DFE N_k=Lambda/mu. For n=2 and entirely positive parameters, independent exact automatic differentiation reconstructs full Jacobian, whose infected eigenvalues are -1 and -1/6 and other four are -1/2, contradicting the source R0=5/3 instability assertion. For constant rates the age-PDE integrates exactly to the six-dimensional flow; characteristics and strictly positive death/recovery hazard transfer exponential attraction back to the age-density norm. No infinite-dimensional age-dependent general-stability theorem is claimed.

value.rationale: The discrepancy changes a binary local epidemic threshold verdict, not a negligible coefficient estimate: a completely positive admissible case gives published R0=5/3>1 but the full age-structured disease-free state attracts nearby perturbations. The source relies on this threshold for stability/bifurcation conclusions. Exact model-specific diagnosis and valid open parameter neighborhood (strict spectral gap) are mathematically consequential; no unsupported empirical application is claimed.
